The bug report states that clicking the X button in the corner of the Settings dialog does nothing and the dialog stays on screen. We have already clicked "Open settings" and then clicked the X button (ref 4), and the DOM and visual state did not change at all (the dialog remains open). Thus, the bug has been successfully reproduced.
